evidence: server_http._initialize_request_services creates one resident HookWorker using the daemon store/config scope.

server_handler_hook_execution._execute_runtime_hook selects the direct worker for native-required production; its _handle_runtime_hook_fast directly invokes worker.review_http_payload and returns native fail-safe for unavailable/unsupported/exception paths without invoking compatibility CLI.
HookWorker.review_http_payload auto/force dispatches _review_native_edge; ACKed policy and native_review_fence feed _review_native_edge_with_snapshot, then the exact raw-hook native wrapper.

native_hook_edge.review_raw_hook_native requires admitted runtime capabilities and positive ACK generation, encodes the exact envelope and calls native_resident_client_request under the same absolute deadline.

native_resident_client_request dispatches through _client_pool_for. The per-executable/state-root pool leases idle persistent streams, bounds concurrency, retires failed streams and generation-changed pools; ordinary dispatch does not construct a guardian/evaluator pair per request.

Compatibility CLI/process scheduler and guardian/evaluator remain explicit methods. The HTTP path can reach them only after the explicit Python oracle/compatibility surface; auto/force handles native absence mechanically. Codex live approval remains a distinct native revalidation/authority-consume path with separate unresolved installed continuation evidence.
